about: The evangelium of the formulary “Saint Stephen, the First Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus was saying to the scribes and Pharisees: Behold, I send to you prophets, and wise men, and scribes; and some of them you will kill and crucify, and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city, so that there may come upon you all the just blood that was shed on the earth, from the blood of Abel the just to the blood of Zechariah, the son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the temple and the altar. Amen I say to you, all these things will come upon this generation. Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those who have been sent to you, how often have I willed to gather your children, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not? Behold, your house will be left to you deserted. For I say to you, you will not see me from now on, until you say: Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.
